speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: The International Enterprise Singapore Board Act (IESBA) outlines the roles and responsibilities of IE Singapore.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: These include promoting and developing the commodity trading industry in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: IE Singapore also regulates the commodity trading industry through the Commodity Trading Act (CTA) and the Rubber Industry Act (RIA).

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: The CTA regulates spot commodity trading and over-the-counter (OTC) commodity derivatives contracts across all types of commodities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: The regulatory oversight of commodity futures contracts had been transferred to the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) in 2008.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: After the transfer, the scope of the CTA will be limited to spot commodity trading.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: The RIA regulates the rubber trading industry, including forward trading, which entails physical delivery of traded rubber.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: These amendments are either consequential to MAS' Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2016 or are administrative in nature.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: This is to provide clarity of IE Singapore's regulatory role under the CTA and the RIA, when the Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2016 comes into force.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: Second, the IESBA will be amended to clarify that IE Singapore can collect, compile and analyse information relating to the commodity trade and industry.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: This gives IE Singapore, the lead agency responsible for the promotion and development of the commodity trading industry, continued access to company and market data for policy formulation purposes.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: Third, the IESBA will be updated to set out the circumstances under which IE Singapore may disclose confidential information related to the commodity trading industry to another public agency.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: This would include disclosure of such information for the purpose of formulating or reviewing policy relating to trade.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: One query I received following the First Reading of the Bill was from the hon Member Mr Louis Ng who pointed out that the use of the SRF in the amended IESBA is not exclusive to the rubber trading industry.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: This is, indeed, the case, to allow for some flexibility in the use of the SRF.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: While the fund has been and will continue to be used to facilitate the promotion and development of the rubber trading industry, it can be tapped upon to promote or develop the broader commodity trading industry, with the view that the benefits so accrued will also accrue to the rubber trading industry.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: Clauses 2, 3, 4 and 5 amend sections 5, 6, 19 and 20 of the IESBA respectively to give legislative effect to these changes.

speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
text: IE Singapore has conducted a public consultation on the draft Bill and there were no objections to the proposed amendments.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: I understand there are no speakers for this Second Reading, but Mr Louis Ng, do you wish to seek a clarification?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: As the Minister of State has mentioned, following the First Reading of the Bill, I did submit some of the concerns to the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, as he mentioned about the Singapore Rubber Fund, I would like to ask if there are any plans or ideas in the pipeline regarding the regulation of rubber trade and industry, bearing in mind that while rubber production in Singapore has fallen over the years, Singapore remains as a big player in this industry.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: In this regard, this is still an industry that the Government should remain interested in and assist as much as possible.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Would it be more helpful for businessmen and women and companies if IE Singapore could also advise and assist any persons, bodies or organisations since IE Singapore is currently already able to act as agents for them?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Mr Ng pointed out that Singapore remains a big player in the rubber industry and asked if there are any pipeline plans relating to the regulation of the rubber trade and industry.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Mr Ng also asked if IE Singapore's advisory and assistance role pertaining to the development or regulation of trade can be extended to persons, bodies or organisations.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: IE Singapore provides advisory and assistance to individuals and public organisations in various ways.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: These include organising industry events, such as the annual Global Trader Dialogue and regulatory advisory seminars, that help individuals and companies keep up to date with the latest developments affecting global commodity trading.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: Through its different assistance schemes, such as the Market Readiness Assistance and Global Partnership programmes, IE Singapore also helps Singapore companies expand their presence overseas.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: To conclude, IE Singapore plays an important role in the promotion and development of the trading industry.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: It also takes on certain regulatory functions to ensure commodity trade is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
